headline: 1973: the price of oil *quadrupled* in months
quote: From three to twelve dollars a barrel
title: When oil prices quadrupled in 1973 (real 1975 film)
caption: From "When the Circuit Breaks: America's Energy Crisis" (1975). The 1973 oil embargo sent prices from $3 to $12 a barrel.
